say.en: Debentures issued five years ago now fall due. The company must repay the lenders without starving the business of cash. In this lesson: State the methods of redemption.
Explain Debenture Redemption Reserve and Debenture Redemption Investment.
Pass entries for redemption at par and at a premium.

body.en: Methods: lump-sum payment on maturity, payment in instalments (often by draw of lots), purchase in the open market, and conversion into shares or new debentures. *Sources*: out of capital (no profits retained) or out of profits (an amount equal to the debentures redeemed is transferred to Debenture Redemption Reserve).
body.kn: ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ, ಕಂತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಖರೀದಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಮೋಚಿಸಬಹುದು. ಲಾಭದಿಂದ ವಿಮೋಚಿಸಿದಾಗ ಸಮಾನ ಮೊತ್ತದ ಲಾಭ ಮೀಸಲಿನ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದಲ್ಲೇ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Section 71(4) of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules under it require certain companies to create a Debenture *Redemption* Reserve out of profits available for dividend. Such companies must also invest or deposit at least 15% of the debentures maturing during the year (Debenture Redemption Investment) before 30 April of that year. After redemption, DRR is transferred to General Reserve.
body.kn: ಸಾಲಪತ್ರ ವಿಮೋಚನಾ ಮೀಸಲನ್ನು ಲಾಭದಿಂದ ರಚಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ವರ್ಷ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯವಾಗುವ ಸಾಲಪತ್ರಗಳ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 15% ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 30ರೊಳಗೆ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ವಿಮೋಚನೆಯ ನಂತರ ಮೀಸಲನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮೀಸಲಿಗೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

Amount due equals 2,000 times 105 rupees equals 2,10,000 rupees.

problem.en: Debentures of ₹4,00,000 mature on 31 March 2026. How much must be invested as Debenture Redemption Investment, and by when?

steps.en: It must be invested or deposited on or before 30 April 2025, i.e. within the year of redemption.
Entry: Debenture Redemption Investment A/c Dr ₹60,000; To Bank A/c ₹60,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Debentures of 4,00,000 rupees mature on 31 March 2026. How much must be invested as Debenture Redemption Investment, and by when?
DRI equals 15 percent of 4,00,000 rupees equals 60,000 rupees.
It must be invested or deposited on or before 30 April 2025, i.e. within the year of redemption.
Entry: Debenture Redemption Investment A over c Dr 60,000 rupees; To Bank A over c 60,000 rupees.
So the answer is 60,000, rupees by 30 April 2025.
